entityLanguage.title: Language for entities copied from CREATE TABLE

jpaAssist.checkEntityId.title: Warn about entities with no @Id, @EmbeddedId or @IdClass, own or inherited

jpaAssist.checkAttributeTypes.title: Warn about @Temporal, @Enumerated and @Version on types the JPA specification does not allow

jpaAssist.checkKotlinEntities.title: Warn about val attributes, read-only collections and data classes in Kotlin entities

jpaAssist.checkClassSignature.title: Warn about entities that are inner classes, interfaces or enums, or also embeddable or mapped superclasses

jpaAssist.checkAttributeSignatures.title: Warn about attributes with two associations, an association on the wrong type, @Id with @EmbeddedId, or getter and field annotations mixed

jpaAssist.checkMappingNames.title: Warn about attribute names in @AttributeOverride, @MapsId, @MapKey and @NamedAttributeNode that the target class does not have

jpaAssist.checkQueryReferences.title: Warn about @Query :parameters the method does not declare, and named queries that do not exist

jpaAssist.checkEntityGraphs.title: Warn about @EntityGraph names that no @NamedEntityGraph declares and attributePaths the repository entity does not have

jpaAssist.checkPersistenceXml.title: Check persistence.xml and JPA mapping files for invalid values and classes that are not in the project

jpaAssist.checkListenerUsage.title: Warn about entity listeners that declare no lifecycle callback or no public constructor without arguments

jpaAssist.checkListenerSignatures.title: Warn about lifecycle callbacks with the wrong parameters or return type
